items.title: 60 years of denial about Israel’s nuclear weapons program confronts a new reality
items.brief: A group of American diplomats was riding in an Israeli helicopter in early 1960 when one of them spotted a construction site rising out of the Negev desert about 20 miles west of the Dead Sea.

items.title: Judge places Thomas Markle, father of Meghan, on house arrest after feds find photos of him sexually abusing minors, DOJ says
items.brief: Thomas Markle , the father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex , was placed on house arrest Friday and faces a charge of possession of child pornography, the Department of Justice announced.

items.title: Stephen Miller replacing Susie Wiles as chief of staff as Trump grows furious with midterm results, sources say
items.brief: Susie Wiles, the White House chief of staff, is departing her role days after catastrophic Republican midterm losses in a seismic staff shakeup at the White House.

items.title: Secret Service arrests armed man near White House allegedly threatening to kill Trump
items.brief: The US Secret Service arrested a man near the White House Thursday who allegedly had several guns in a stolen car and was threatening to kill President Donald Trump.

items.title: Paraguay president impeached and under house arrest following bank collapse scandal
items.brief: Paraguay’s senate has voted to impeach President Santiago Peña, who is facing a criminal investigation and is under house arrest following the collapse of a major bank he had business links to.
